admission.justification: Launch identity, four-tool registration and seat validation live in distinct owners, and the launch and bound-server tests exercise their composition beside the general tools.

applicability: Normal AR task-server startup for a process launched as an explainer, and calls to that bound server.
conditions: Launch supplies both the workspace marker and the capability binding.
The binding validates repository/task/leaf workspace shape, required values and a positive integer generation before registration.
Registration supplies the same explainer implementations on the already-created server instance.
Calls to the four explainer-owned tools check the launch binding against the current seat before their handler runs.

Central read-only annotations are attached at registration time via AgentsRememberMCP.add_tool (enforce_read_only_marks=True); they describe capability and do not grant permission or prove process-wide purity.
exclusions: An ordinary process with neither marker nor binding retains the ordinary roster.
This statement does not claim operating-system confinement from tool discovery alone.
General AR tools retain their ordinary admission rather than explainer-only dispatch confinement.
statement: A valid launch-owned explainer binding adds the explainer’s four tools to AR’s general tools on the normal task server. Calls to those four tools revalidate the exact launched seat. Invalid or lost marker-backed launch bindings refuse service, and every registered tool receives its central read-only mark; an unclassified registered tool prevents server creation.
title: Bound explainer server adds four tools with seat guard and read-only marks
